title: healthrelay.catalog-error v1
description: The error body the catalog returns for every non-2xx response. Two fields, both closed: an error carries no user, device, intake, query or internal detail.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Clients branch on this, never on the message.

message.description: Short, safe, user-facing sentence. Never an email address, identifier, query, SQL or stack trace.
